Approved paid order target/kind/catalog/effective term must agree; idempotent consumption and expected entitlement version

binary_routes.guard: Existing principal-scoped upload session binds purpose, immutable object metadata, maximum bytes and expiry. Compare offset+chunk digest: exact retry returns accepted offset; different bytes at same offset conflict. No target filesystem path supplied by client. Finalize computes whole object digest/length server-side; metadata+audit/outbox publication coordinated with object state; quarantine then finalized; orphan cleanup/tombstone reconciliation after restart.

binary_routes.response: application/octet-stream ciphertext or approved evidence attachment; Content-Length/Range, digest and immutable object id
binary_routes.guard: No object bytes before per-shop/purpose authorization; backup bytes require an expiring grant scoped to principal and object; support bytes require validated support.view and persisted ticket/shop attachment binding; local verified restore remains separate

auth.admin: HTTPS; server-issued secure session; HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite cookie, CSRF/origin checks on mutations; MFA and action-scoped fresh stepup; security revision; capability RBAC; configurable idle/absolute TTL. No shared generic IsAdmin.
auth.installation: HTTPS plus installation asymmetric request proof (key id, timestamp, nonce, method/path/body digest) bound to authenticated install/shop and challenge; replay window/config; installed private key never leaves machine; bootstrap token only activation scope. Never reuse admin cookie/service secret.
auth.service: Restricted network/service credentials with signing purpose/allowlist and issuance revision validation; dedicated production custody; no private keys in ordinary DB or response.
auth.bootstrap: Rate-limited exact bootstrap endpoints; token/challenge scoped and hashed at rest; no implicit tenant authority.
auth.challenge: Short-lived preauthentication challenge only, zero business capabilities; MFA proof consumes or rate-limits exact challenge; privileged routes require authenticated MFA session. A trusted provider may return full session only with independently verified MFA, never caller mfaSatisfied flag.
auth.bootstrap_installation: Rate-limited activation-only bootstrap. Server challenge binds one-time token hash, install ID, submitted public-key bytes and recomputed key fingerprint, hardware binding, nonce, method/path/payload digest and expiry. Verify proof of possession with submitted key; self-asserted key/fingerprint alone grants NO license or authenticated installation authority. Check token server record and eligible paid license/shop. Only register/redemption/status until fresh human approval/current-state check and certificate issuance; ordinary reconcile/upload endpoints require approved persisted installation identity. Prevent cross-token key substitution/replay.

canonicalization: Versioned canonical JSON profile chosen and tested against actual existing validator. UTF8, deterministic object-key order, stable number/time/null semantics, no arbitrary normalization changing intent. Fingerprint covers fingerprintVersion+operationType+canonical payload+principal/shop binding. Sign immutable envelope version/purpose/key/profile/authority/policy and payload digest. Reject unsupported profiles/algorithms and purpose confusion. Algorithm never selected by untrusted header alone.
semantic_rules: Format validation and all domain invariants require implementation tests; structural JSON is not a running API
Absent policy/config fails issuance/affected activation clearly; never invent global commercial values or treat network outage as suspension
Signed dates monotonic: validFrom<=leaseExpires<=offlineGraceUntil; approved extension applies only until exact extensionEndUtc and recorded after-extension policy
Shop/license/install/actor references must agree with authenticated principal; primaryCapacity always1 in V1
Hardware uncertainty is reviewable; hard-deny activation/token/payment/cross-shop/revocation is not generic override
SensitiveApproval approver!=requester, exact action digest, expiry/version/step-up rechecked atomically before execute
No local keyed HMAC authenticity verification is claimed by keyless central vault; opaque local manifest authentication retained for local restore
Plan/role/provider/numeric values are explicit configured IDs, not static plan enums or new owner-approved defaults
Commercial termKind LIFETIME requires validUntilUtc null and no billing period/recurring base renewal; fixed term requires real expiry after start
Support/premium expiration does not expire valid lifetime base entitlement or trigger base subscription lock/watermark
Commercial validity is distinct from signed certificate/lease verification dates and original outage/authorized security policy
PricingSnapshot/order termKind and signed commercialTerm must match authoritative plan/catalog; client termKind cannot grant lifetime for a timed purchase

PriceRequest/Order.termKind and billingPeriodId describe PURCHASED ITEM, never implicitly the existing base term. purchaseTarget binds BASE_LICENSE/SUPPORT/PREMIUM_UPGRADE and existing base license for addons. Lifetime base may purchase FIXED_TERM support with annual/monthly billing period; that does not convert its base to fixed term.

Base license.renew/extend reject target LIFETIME as inapplicable; addon.renew is distinct paid-order-backed entitlement command; plan conversion has explicit approved order/authority revision and is not disguised renewal.
EXPIRED add-on must retain real historical expiry; NOT_PURCHASED may have null expiry. Datetime chronology, catalog ownership and finite periods still enforced server-side.
bootstrap_boundary: Only authorized admin activation.issue after approved commercial eligibility creates/delivers token; store hash and immutable binding, not raw secret. Approved configured delivery channel sends token once with delivery/outbox reference; operation replay returns reference, never logs or reissues secret. Challenge requests never issue a commercial token, perform sale, enroll unrestricted authority or reveal cross-shop token existence. Human approval consumes once after first-redemption policy. Installation private key stays machine protected; public key is checked against proof and server binding.
auth_result_boundary: PreAuthChallenge has no sessionId/capabilities, businessAuthority=false, only MFA endpoint allowed. Authenticated AdminSession requires mfaSatisfied=true from verified provider. StepUpGrant binds session, exact actionScope/targetPayloadSha256 and expiry; cannot grant a wider general session or survive privilege revision.
